import dataclasses
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT.parents[1]))
from distill.process_security import resolve_executable,sanitized_package_env
from distill.ingestors.youtube.local_frames import capture_local_video_frames

video=ROOT.parent/'issue61-67-trial/assets/synthetic.mp4'
audio=ROOT/'captionless-synthetic.wav'
output=ROOT/'spoken-visual-synthetic.mp4'
ffmpeg=resolve_executable('ffmpeg')
if not ffmpeg:
    raise RuntimeError('installed ffmpeg required')
env=sanitized_package_env()
env.pop('FFREPORT',None)
command=[ffmpeg,'-nostdin','-hide_banner','-loglevel','error','-y',
 '-protocol_whitelist','file,pipe','-format_whitelist','mov','-i',str(video),
 '-protocol_whitelist','file,pipe','-format_whitelist','wav','-i',str(audio),
 '-map','0:v:0','-map','1:a:0','-map_metadata','-1','-c:v','copy',
 '-af','apad','-t','125','-c:a','aac','-b:a','96k','-threads','1',str(output)]
subprocess.run(command,env=env,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
 stderr=subprocess.PIPE,check=True,timeout=30,creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW)
frames=capture_local_video_frames(output,ROOT/'combined-frames',timestamps_ms=(0,60000,67000,120000),timeout_seconds=30)
receipt={'source':str(output),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(output.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'bytes':output.stat().st_size,'audio_source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(audio.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'visual_source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(video.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'late_spoken_correction_seconds':65,'capture':dataclasses.asdict(frames),
 'scope':'local mux and actual frame capture only; no additional ASR or model call'}
(ROOT/'combined-source.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2))
